description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy metrics for LLMs, specifically showing how final accuracy, change in accuracy (Δ Accuracy), and initial accuracy vary as a function of initial confidence. The x-axis represents "Initial Confidence," ranging from 0.91 to 0.99 in linear scale with tick marks at each 0.01 increment. The y-axis represents "Accuracy," scaled linearly from 0.0 to 1.0. The "Final Accuracy" is depicted by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.90, rising to a peak of 0.99 at initial confidence 0.93, then generally declining to about 0.90 at initial confidence 0.99. The "Δ Accuracy" is shown as a dashed orange line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 0.50, peaking at about 0.65 at initial confidence 0.92, then generally decreasing to approximately 0.15 at initial confidence 0.99. The "Initial Accuracy" is represented by a dashed green line with square markers, starting at approximately 0.35, declining to about 0.25 at initial confidence 0.92, then rising to approximately 0.85 at initial confidence 0.98 before declining again to about 0.75 at initial confidence 0.99. All data points are accompanied by error bars indicating variability.
